name: English

ui.Rien n'est envoyé sans ton accord : tu v: Nothing is sent without your approval: you see the full text first, and you submit it yourself on GitHub.
ui.Ce que tu attendais, et ce que tu as vu: What you expected, and what you saw instead.
ui.Chemins, noms, adresses et clés sont ret: Paths, names, addresses and keys are removed automatically. Review this text and edit it if needed. It never contains keys, firmware or games.
ui.Il te faut un compte GitHub : ton pseudo: You need a GitHub account: your username will be visible on the issue.
ui.Rapport prêt : relis-le avant de l'envoy: Report ready: read it before sending.
ui.Rapport trop long pour être prérempli :: Report too long to fit in the link: attach bug-report.txt to the issue.
ui.Vérifie le ticket dans ton navigateur, p: Check the issue in your browser, then submit it.
ui.Choisis l'émulateur de chaque jeu, puis: Choose an emulator for each game, then launch the game. Your choice is remembered.
ui.Après une mise à jour, l'ancienne versio: After an update, the previous version stays in Old Versions. Your data does not change.
ui.Filtre du fichier à télécharger (faculta: Filter for the file to download (optional, regular expression)
ui.N'ajoute que des sources de confiance :: Only add sources you trust: an emulator is a program that runs on your PC.
ui.En cas d'écran noir ou de graphismes cas: If you get a black screen or broken graphics after an update
ui.Tes autres raccourcis ne changent pas. A: Your other shortcuts do not change. After moving the NX2 Launcher folder, simply click Apply to Steam.
Steam not found on this PC.
ui.Steam sera fermé puis rouvert si nécessa: Steam will close and reopen if needed: quit any running Steam game first. Downloaded covers are copied too.
ui.Facultatif. Sauvegardes, profil et régla: Optional. Saves, profile and settings only: keys and firmware are never sent.
ui.Synchroniser avant et après chaque parti: Sync before and after each play session
ui.Si le cloud est plus récent, la version: If the cloud is newer, the local version is replaced automatically, after making a backup. If both changed, the tool shows the dates and lets you choose.
ui.Google Drive pour ordinateur, OneDrive,: Google Drive for desktop, OneDrive, Dropbox or a NAS. No API needed.
ui.L'outil ne voit que les fichiers qu'il a: The tool only sees the files it created.
ui.Sur console.cloud.google.com, crée un pr: On console.cloud.google.com, create a project and enable the Google Drive API.
ui.Écran de consentement : type Externe, pu: Consent screen: set the type to External, then publish the app (otherwise sign-in expires after 7 days).
ui.Crée un client OAuth de type Application: Create an OAuth client of type Desktop app, then paste its ID and secret here.
ui.Termine la connexion dans ton navigateur: Finish signing in in your browser...
ui.L'emplacement de tes données et les opti: Where your data lives, and the tool's options.
ui.Vérifie sur GitHub si une nouvelle versi: Checks GitHub for a new version.
ui.Vérifier au démarrage, pour l'outil et l: Check at startup, for the tool and the emulators
ui.Mis à jour en dehors de NX2 Launcher : l: Updated outside NX2 Launcher: the previous version was not kept.
ui.Une version plus récente peut moins bien: A newer version can run a game worse. The current version stays in Old Versions, and your saves are copied first.
ui.GPL-3.0-or-later. Tu peux utiliser, étud: GPL-3.0-or-later. You may use, study, change and share this software under its terms. It comes with no warranty.
ui.Quelques minutes pour tout préparer. Tou: It only takes a few minutes to get everything ready. You can change it all later.
ui.importer ce qui existe déjà sur ce PC, s: import anything already on this PC, if you wish
ui.installer un émulateur et trouver tes je: install an emulator and find your games
ui.choisir tes options : jaquettes et cloud: choose your options: covers and cloud.
ui.Cet outil ne fournit ni clés, ni firmwar: This tool provides no keys, firmware or games: they must come from your own console.
ui.Coche ce que tu veux importer. Le dossie: Select what you want to import. The original folder is never changed and existing files are not overwritten.
Nothing found automatically on this PC.
ui.Les émulateurs en ont besoin pour lancer: Emulators need them to run your games.
ui., issu de ta propre console. Un fichier: file, dumped from your own console. A title.keys file next to it is copied too.
ui.Il faut le firmware de ta console : une: You need your console's firmware: a .zip archive or a folder containing .nca files.
ui.Tu peux continuer sans, mais aucun jeu n: You can continue without them, but no game will start until the keys and firmware are installed.
ui.À côté de l'outil, rien sur le disque sy: Next to the tool, nothing on the system drive. Ideal for an external drive.
ui.Sur ce PC, dans le dossier de ton compte: On this PC, in your account folder.
ui.Fritchii est le plus polyvalent sous Win: Fritchii is the most versatile on Windows: try it first.
ui.Dernière étape. Ces deux options sont fa: Last step. Both of these are optional, and you can set them up later.
ui.Retrouve tes sauvegardes sur un autre PC: Keep your saves in sync across PCs. Set it up whenever you like, from the Cloud page.
Give this emulator a name first.
ui.L'installation guidée t'aide à tout prép: The guided setup helps you get everything ready.
ui.Reprendre les étapes d'installation et d: Go through the setup and import steps again.
ui.Pour ajouter une langue, dépose un fichi: To add a language, drop a file in Manager/locales. The instructions are in the project's locales folder.
ui.Je confirme que mes clés, mon firmware e: I confirm that my keys, firmware and games come from my own console, and that I use this tool at my own risk.
ui.Cet outil ne fournit aucun de ces fichie: This tool provides none of these files. It is not affiliated with any console maker and comes with no warranty.
ui.Pour les bugs de l'outil uniquement: For bugs in the tool only
ui.Installation, import, mises à jour, Stea: Setup, import, updates, Steam, cloud, the window. A crash or a graphics problem in a game is caused by the emulator: check its project, using the Releases button on the Emulators page.
ui.Utile si l'outil n'arrive pas à lancer u: Useful if the tool cannot start an emulator. The last 200 lines, with personal details removed.
ui.Cet outil n'existerait pas sans les proj: This tool would not exist without the Eden, Eglantine, Lichii, Fritchii, PokeDinner, Orchid, SmileyTatsu, Selevet and Eglantine Steam Deck projects, the wichforks community guide, SteamGridDB and the open source libraries it uses.
ui.Cet outil ne fournit ni clés, ni firmwar: This tool provides no keys, firmware or games: they must come from your own console. It is not affiliated with any console maker.
ui.Attention : le guide ne cite pas ce choi: Warning: the guide does not list this choice for your system or graphics card.
ui.Ce sont des retours de joueurs, sans gar: These are player reports, not guarantees.
ui.Tous les émulateurs du guide sont déjà d: Every emulator in the guide is already in your list.
ui.Le journal d'erreurs de NX2 Launcher est: NX2 Launcher's error log is always included, with personal details removed too.
ui.Personnaliser aussi le fond et le texte: Also customize the background and text
ui.L'ancienne version reste dans Old Versio: The previous version stays in Old Versions, and your saves are copied first.
ui.Revenir à une ancienne version: Go back to an older version
ui.La version actuelle reste dans Old Versi: The current version stays in Old Versions, and your saves are copied first.
ui.Avant de jouer et avant de changer de ve: Before you play and before an emulator changes version, the tool copies your saves, profile and settings to Save Backups if anything changed. Keys and firmware are not copied.
ui.Dépose l'image sur un jeu, dans la page: Drop the image on a game, on the Games page.
ui.Ce fichier n'est pas une image PNG, JPEG: This file is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or ICO image.
ui.Aucun jeu pour l'instant : ajoute le dos: No games yet: add the folder they are in from the Settings page, or put them in NX2 Launcher's games folder.
ui.Dossier retiré de la liste. Tes jeux n'o: Folder removed from the list. Your games have not moved.
ui.Pour les émulateurs de la liste fournie,: For the emulators in the built-in list, including from Steam. Esc leaves it by default.
ui.NX2 Launcher lit les jeux là où ils sont: NX2 Launcher reads games where they are, subfolders included, without moving or copying anything.
ui.Tu choisis ce que tu ajoutes, et c'est à: You choose what you add, and you are responsible for following those sites' terms.
ui.Un raccourci vers l'outil dans Steam. En: A shortcut to the tool in Steam. Full screen in Big Picture and Gaming Mode, a window otherwise. F11 switches between them.
ui.Indique le dossier où se trouvent déjà t: Choose the folder your games are already in: nothing is moved or copied. You can also put your .nup, .nsp or .xci files in NX2 Launcher's games folder.
ui.Avec une clé gratuite SteamGridDB (Prefe: With a free SteamGridDB key (Preferences, then API on their site), the tool downloads images for your games. Otherwise, add your own from the Games page, with the Images button.
ui.Il garde ses émulateurs et ses données d: It keeps its emulators and data in a Files folder next to itself. Choose a place where it can stay.
ui.Attention : ce dossier sert plutôt aux f: Careful: this folder is usually for temporary files, and it often gets emptied.
ui.Idéal sur un disque externe, ou si tu as: Ideal on an external drive, or if you already chose this folder.
ui.Dans ton compte, sans droits d'administr: In your account, without administrator rights, on the system drive.
ui.Par exemple sur un disque avec plus de p: For example on a drive with more room. A NX2 Launcher subfolder will be created there.
ui.NX2 Launcher s'ouvre à son nouvel emplac: NX2 Launcher is opening in its new place...
ui.Un émulateur est ouvert hors de NX2 Laun: An emulator is open outside NX2 Launcher.
ui.Confirmer : une partie non sauvegardée s: Confirm: unsaved progress will be lost
ui.La couverture dans NX2 Launcher et dans: The cover in NX2 Launcher and in Steam
ui.Le grand fond de la page du jeu dans Ste: The large background on the game's Steam page
ui.Le logo posé sur ce fond dans Steam: The logo shown over that background in Steam
ui.La petite icône du jeu dans Steam: The game's small icon in Steam
ui.Choisis une image ou glisse-la sur la bo: Choose an image or drag it onto the right box. The file name does not matter.
ui.Pour tous tes jeux. Coche seulement ce q: For all your games. Tick only what you want.
ui.Remplacer les images que j'ai déjà: Replace the images I already have
ui.Sinon, seules les images manquantes sont: Otherwise, only missing images are downloaded.
Tick at least one image type.
ui.Pour tous tes émulateurs. Les réglages p: For all your emulators. Per-game settings in the emulator still come first. Close the emulator before changing a setting.
ui.La langue des jeux n'agit que si le jeu: The game language only works if the game includes it. Some games also need the right region.
ui.Le plus simple : page Jeux, puis Images: The easiest way: on the Games page, open Images on the game you want, to see and change all its images. You can also download them from SteamGridDB with your free key, or from your own image sources.
ui.Pour tous tes jeux, quel que soit l'émul: For all your games, whatever the emulator: they share the same data folder. A game can have its own settings, from the gear on its cover. Close the emulator before changing a setting.
ui.Le nom du fichier de ce jeu ne contient: This game's file name does not contain its ID, such as [0100000000010000], so NX2 Launcher does not know where the emulator keeps its settings. Change them in the emulator itself.
ui.Ce jeu a aussi ses propres valeurs pour: This game also has its own values for these settings. NX2 Launcher cannot change them: edit them in the emulator, or set them back to common.
ui.Ferme l'émulateur avant de changer un ré: Close the emulator before changing a setting.
ui.Ce jeu suit de nouveau le réglage commun: This game follows the common setting again.
ui.Aucune source active pour l'instant : aj: No active source yet: add your free SteamGridDB key or a source, just below.
ui.Des images faites par la communauté. Il: Images made by the community. It needs a free key, tied to your SteamGridDB account.
ui.Avec « Toutes », NX2 Launcher essaie tes: With “All”, NX2 Launcher tries your sources in order, then SteamGridDB. To remove a source, turn it off or delete its file in the folder.
ui.Seulement si le jeu contient cette langu: Only if the game includes this language.
ui.Certains jeux demandent aussi la bonne r: Some games also need the right region.
ui.Aucun pour l'instant. Ouvre un jeu avec: None yet. Open a game with the gear on its cover to give it its own settings.
ui.Tes sources d'images, dont SteamGridDB,: Your image sources, SteamGridDB included, and the folder where images are kept.
ui.Langue, région, mode TV, résolution et l: Language, region, TV mode, resolution and the rest are on the Emulators page.
ui.Pour tous les émulateurs : ils partagent: For every emulator: they share the same controls and profiles.
ui.Aucune manette détectée : branche-la, el: No controller found: plug it in and it will show up here.
ui.Choisir une manette remplit toutes les t: Choosing a controller fills in every button, as in the emulators. Then click a control to change it, and press the button you want. Controls light up as you press them.
ui.Pousse le stick vers la droite, puis ver: Push the stick right, then up. To swap the axes, start with up.
ui.Ferme-le avant de changer tes contrôles: Close it before changing your controls: it would replace them with its own when it closes.
ui.Tu peux changer tes contrôles : ils sero: You can change your controls: they are applied as soon as it closes, for its next game. To change the buttons of the game being played, use the emulator's own Controls window.
ui.Réglage gardé : il sera appliqué à la fe: Setting kept: it is applied when the emulator closes, for its next game.
ui.Les réglages gardés pendant la partie so: The settings kept during the game are now applied.
ui.Réglage enregistré : il sera appliqué au: Setting saved: it is applied to the game as soon as you go back to it.
Setting applied to the game being played.
ui.Le réglage n'a pas pu être appliqué pend: The setting could not be applied during the game: it will be the next time the game starts.
ui.Touches appliquées tout de suite dans la: Controls applied right away in the game.
This controller is not plugged in.
ui.Le mode portable va avec le type de mane: Handheld mode goes with the “Handheld” controller type of player 1.
ui.Plus fidèles, mais certaines manettes vi: More faithful, but some controllers vibrate less well.
ui.À changer seulement si une manette n'est: Change these only if a controller is not recognized. NX2 Launcher also follows them when it reads controllers.
ui.Pour plus de 4 manettes Xbox sous Window: For more than 4 Xbox controllers on Windows.
ui.Tes contrôles sont partagés par tous les: Your controls are shared by every emulator. Before each game, if the controller they were set with is not plugged in but one of the same model is, NX2 Launcher moves your controls to it: you can play with either one without setting anything again.
ui.Un jeu peut avoir son propre profil par: A game can have its own profile per player, from the gear on its cover.
ui.Un profil donné à un joueur ne sert que: A profile given to a player is only used for this game. Profiles are created on the Controller page.
Profile given to this player for this game.
ui.Ce joueur suit de nouveau les contrôles: This player follows the common controls again.
ui.Clique sur une touche du dessin ou de la: Click a button on the drawing or in the list to set it.
ui.Naviguer dans les menus de l'émulateur à: Navigate the emulator's menus with the controller
ui.Coupée, le jeu tourne aussi vite que le: When off, the game runs as fast as the PC allows.
ui.Les mêmes dans tous les émulateurs. Les: The same in every emulator. Button combinations work during a game, on player 1's controller.
ui.Sur une manette Xbox, HOME est le bouton: On an Xbox controller, HOME is the Xbox button. If the Windows Game Bar opens, turn off opening it with this button in the Windows settings.
ui.Dis comment ce jeu tourne chez toi. NX2: Tell how this game runs for you. NX2 Launcher fills in the form: game, emulator and version, graphics card, system and play time. You check it, pick the result and send it. A GitHub account is needed.
ui.Voir les rapports de toutes les sources: See the reports from every source
ui.Le site de rapports de Lichii ne connaît: The Lichii report site does not know this game.
ui.Tous les rapports de ce jeu sur le site: All of this game's reports on the Lichii site
ui.Les boutons qui servent à te déplacer da: The buttons that move you around NX2 Launcher. They stay in NX2 Launcher: the emulators never see them, and your game controls do not change.
ui.Sur une liste de choix, appuie sur Valid: On a list of choices, press Confirm to open it, then left or right to choose. Confirm keeps the choice, Back cancels it.
ui.Gauche ou droite pour choisir, A pour ga: Left or right to choose, A to keep, B to cancel.

uiPatterns: ^(.+) : nouveau fichier publié sous le même numéro, installé \(vérifié : somme de contrôle SHA-256\)\. L'ancien est gardé dans Old Versions\.$
$1: a new file was published under the same number, installed (verified: SHA-256 checksum). The old one is kept in Old Versions.
^(.+) : nouveau fichier publié sous le même numéro, installé \(vérifié : taille\)\. L'ancien est gardé dans Old Versions\.$
$1: a new file was published under the same number, installed (verified: size). The old one is kept in Old Versions.
^GitHub limite le nombre de vérifications par heure : réessaie dans (\d+) min\.$
GitHub limits the number of checks per hour: try again in $1 min.
Saves, keys and settings. Current location: $1
^(\d+) raccourci\(s\) pointe\(nt\) vers un ancien emplacement : clique sur Enregistrer dans Steam pour les réparer\.$
$1 shortcut(s) point to an old location: click Apply to Steam to fix them.

uiPatterns.Fork Lichii de Frizti : le plus polyvale: Frizti's Lichii fork: the most versatile
uiPatterns.Fork Eglantine conseillé pour Mario Kart: Eglantine fork recommended for Mario Kart World
uiPatterns.Fork Eglantine conseillé pour Donkey Kon: Eglantine fork recommended for Donkey Kong Bananza, tuned for Zen 3 processors
uiPatterns.Eglantine corrigé pour le Steam Deck: Eglantine with fixes for the Steam Deck

wichforks guide$1$2. These are player reports, not guarantees.
^(\d+) rapport\(s\) de joueurs sur le site de Lichii\.$
$1 player report(s) on the Lichii site.
